summary: @jsonbecker But who is the reference point. A Tumblr user sick of engendered censorship might turn to turnkey @microdotblog, someone with your skill may build a Jekyll or Hugo site. Someone like me falls in between. Our reference is what works for you, maybe someone else wants it too.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@jsonbecker But who is the reference point. A Tumblr user sick of engendered censorship might turn to turnkey @microdotblog, someone with your skill may build a Jekyll or Hugo site.

Someone like me falls in between.

Our reference is what works for you, maybe someone else wants it too.
